gloss: to rise to the surface, to emerge

definitions.gloss: to rise to the surface, to float up
definitions.explanation: To come up from below the surface of water or another liquid.

definitions.gloss: to emerge, to come to light, to stand out
definitions.explanation: For something hidden or unclear to become visible or apparent. Often used for problems, facts, or figures that become clear.

examples.japanese: {泡|あわ}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がった。
{沈|しず}んだ{船|ふね}がゆっくり{浮|う}き{上|あ}がってきた。
examples.english: The sunken ship slowly rose to the surface.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}の{中|なか}から{大|おお}きな{魚|さかな}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がってきた。
examples.english: A large fish rose up from the water.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}で{問題点|もんだいてん}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がった。
{暗闇|くらやみ}の{中|なか}で{人影|ひとかげ}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: A figure emerged in the darkness.

examples.japanese: データを{分析|ぶんせき}した{結果|けっか}、{新|あたら}しい{事実|じじつ}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がってきた。
examples.english: As a result of analyzing the data, new facts came to light.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: {浮|う}く + {上|あ}がる. Pattern: Xが{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる (X rises/emerges).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {浮|う}き{上|あ}がっている = 'is floating' or 'has emerged.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{水面|すいめん}に{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる (rise to the surface)
・{真相|しんそう}が{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる (the truth emerges)
・くっきりと{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる (stand out clearly)

NUANCE: When used figuratively, often implies that something previously hidden has become apparent.
